usageNotes: Use this to initialize a raw block device as an LVM thin-pool on a specific node — a prerequisite for VM/CT disk storage backed by thin provisioning. The target device must be unpartitioned and unused (no existing filesystem or LVM metadata); the operation is irreversible on that device's data. Returns a task UPID; poll the task endpoint to confirm completion before referencing the pool as storage.

examples.summary: Create a thinpool named 'vmdata' on /dev/sdb and auto-register it as a PVE storage

tips: Verify the device is truly unused first via get_nodes_node_disks_list (or lsblk on the node) — LVM initialization will destroy any existing data.
Setting add_storage=true requires the calling token/user to also hold Datastore.Allocate on /storage, in addition to Sys.Modify on /.
The thinpool name must conform to pve-storage-id format (alphanumeric, hyphens, underscores; no spaces); it becomes the storage ID visible across the cluster.
After creation, the thinpool appears as a 'lvmthin' storage type in datacenter storage; set content types (images, rootdir) separately via the storage edit endpoint.
